title: Containers
description: Every Docker container on every Spark, with its state, health and what it costs.

panels.title: Should be running
panels.description: Stopped although the restart policy says otherwise, and not stopped by hand.

panels.title: Stopped
panels.description: Leftovers nobody expects to be up.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Blank GPU memory means none. Blank network means the container shares the host's network, so its traffic cannot be told apart. Exited containers are listed with their status.

targets.expr: max by (node, container, project, image, status) (spark_container_info{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"})
max by (node, container) (time() - spark_container_started_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"} and on (node, container) spark_container_running == 1)

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set. GPU memory is separate on this hardware.

panels.title: What stopped or restarted
panels.description: Every container started in the last 24 hours, whether by a person, a deploy or a crash. Automatic restarts is Docker's lifetime count under the restart policy.

targets.expr: max by (node, container, project) (spark_container_started_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"} * 1000 and on (node, container) (changes(spark_container_started_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"}[24h]) > 0))

max by (node, container, project) (spark_container_exit_code{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"} and on (node, container) (changes(spark_container_started_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"}[24h]) > 0))

max by (node, container, project) (spark_container_restarts_total{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"} and on (node, container) (changes(spark_container_started_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node",project=~"$project"}[24h]) > 0))
